Assessment

#242 has corrected its earlier advisory, performance-isolation, explicit-help, README-recovery and stderr-contract findings. A separate test assumes recursive native Git tag peeling and fails under the older supported listing capability.

    return subprocess.run([REAL_GIT, *args], cwd=root, env=ENV, input=input, check=True, capture_output=True).stdout.decode().strip()

def commit(root, message, files, parent=None):
    raw = f"commit refs/heads/main\ncommitter Fixture <fixture@example.invalid> 1700000000 +0000\ndata {len(message.encode())}\n{message}\n"
    if parent:
        raw += f"from {parent}\n"
    for name, value in files.items():
